name: Real-time game speed
description: ASTRO BOT 1.04: the world advances by the time frames really take, instead of 1/60 s per frame (slow motion below 60 FPS). Port of AstroQuest known_title.cpp.
title: CUSA12392

hooks.evidence: sceGnmSubmitDone (NID yvZ73uQUqrk, aerolib) takes no arguments and returns int; AstroQuest calls its time step from this entry (gnmdriver.cpp OnFrameSubmitted). The hook enters at the eboot PLT entry of the import, found at install time.
